evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME pointing at a fresh temp root. Create a new project for Acme Robotics. Organization: Acme Robotics. Active person: Maya Chen, Head of Growth. Workspace: Default GTM Workspace for outbound to warehouse operations teams. Public sources: https://example.com/acme-robotics and https://example.com/maya-chen. Confirm the write preview and create the project.
evals.expected_output: A new git-backed GTM context project is created under the redirected GTM_HOME with registry, gtm.yaml, organization, person, workspace context, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and no skill-owned ICP/persona/scoring files.
expectations: Uses the redirected GTM_HOME and does not touch live ~/.gtm
Creates registry.json and a project folder with gtm.yaml
Creates organization.md, a person file, and workspaces/default/context.md
Does not create icps.md, personas.md, account-scoring.md, or lead-scoring.md
Reports no remote push or external side effects

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Validate the active Acme Robotics project and repair missing or stale setup files if needed. Confirm any repair preview.
evals.expected_output: The fixture project is validated against the setup contract, with any missing setup-only files repaired and no downstream skill-owned files overwritten.
expectations: Resolves the active project from registry.json
Checks gtm.yaml, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, organization.md, person file, and workspace context
Preserves icps.md, personas.md, account-scoring.md, and lead-scoring.md
Reports created, preserved, repaired, skipped, and failed steps distinctly

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Select the Acme Robotics default workspace for Maya Chen and summarize the active context without changing durable project files.
evals.expected_output: The active project/person/workspace is selected through registry local state and summarized without rewriting committed project files.
expectations: Resolves project, person, and workspace from the redirected registry
Keeps active local state in registry.json
Does not modify organization.md, gtm.yaml, or workspace context for a selection-only request
Recommends ICP and persona definition only if they are missing

evals.prompt: Use the GTM setup skill with GTM_HOME pointing at a fresh temp root. Create a new project for SafePath Labs, but the requested workspace id is ../escape and the source links include https://example.com/safepath, https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123?token=secret, and http://localhost:3000/debug. Do not write until the preview proves path safety and source-link handling.
evals.expected_output: The setup flow rejects the path-escaping workspace id, classifies source links before saving, keeps unsafe/private links out of committed context, and waits for corrected safe ids or explicit confirmation before any durable write.
expectations: Rejects or asks to replace the ../escape workspace id before deriving paths
Does not create files outside the canonical project root
Classifies the public example.com link as saveable after confirmation
Does not commit the tokenized HubSpot URL or localhost URL
Uses safe labels or omission reasons for unsafe/private links
Does not perform a durable write until the path and source-link preview is safe
